transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As part of our normal launch-governance process, I need each functional counsel to state any legal condition that must be included in the launch packet before I can give final authorization for the October 1 external availability of our clinical documentation platform. Please go through your areas and flag anything you believe must be added or modified.
